name: Volunteer with North Vancouver Recreation and Culture (NVRC)
org: North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission
what_you_do: Help with swimming, young kids programs, fitness and special events. You can also help with general recreation.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older. Some roles need an older age or certificates (for example Aquatics needs age 15, Bronze Cross and Swim Instructor). Under 18 needs a parent signature.
duration: Varies. Early years roles ask for 4 to 6 months.
how_to_apply: There are eight steps. Fill out the online form. Give two references. Sign the volunteer agreement. Get a police check at the RCMP where you live. Sign the photo release. Upload your forms. Go to orientation. Then email volunteer@nvrc.ca.
notes: Contact volunteer@nvrc.ca or 604-983-6345. The police check must be done where you live.
